description: Unit test class for ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter, testing immutability, null input handling, default acknowledgment labels, filtering of acknowledgment labels, and behavior when acknowledgment is already requested.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of ThingModifyCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToApplyNullCommand
methods.description: Verifies that passing a null command throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: doNothingIfNoResponseRequired
methods.description: Ensures no change occurs when responseRequired is false.

methods.name: addPersistedAckLabelByDefault
methods.description: Checks that the TWIN_PERSISTED acknowledgment label is added by default when response is requested.

methods.name: filterOutOtherBuiltInDittoAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Verifies only TWIN_PERSISTED is retained when multiple acknowledgment labels are present.

methods.name: doNotAddPersistedAckLabelToAlreadyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Ensures no change when acknowledgment is already explicitly requested.
